question: From their mother’s side, Mughal rulers were the descendants of _________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Genghis Khan**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Mughal rulers were descendants of Genghis Khan from their mother's side**
 
• The Mughal rulers **were descendants of two great lineages of rulers.**
 
• **On their mother's side, they were descendants of Genghis Khan, the Mongol ruler who ruled over parts of China and Central Asia.**
 
• On their father's side, they were descendants of Timur, the ruler of Iran, Iraq, and modern-day Turkey
